VR hand models (glove_left.md5mesh, glove_right.md5mesh) and textures/vr/hands/*

Based on "Glove" by Normal Map Enjoyer
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/glove-7cb36be3202e41fcbb444cbf43d83745
licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

Changes: only the glove part is used (bracer, laces and wraps removed), the cuff opening is closed,
a hand skeleton with finger joints was added, the model was mirrored for the right hand, converted to
MD5 and the textures were resized and converted (specular map derived from the roughness map).
Built with tools/vr_hands/build_hands.py.
